name: Ormer's Revenge
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The situation is severe, that much is for sure.  When we uncovered these bones it attracted the Raptors.  These filthy beasts killed my brethren and trapped me, Merrin and the poor Prospector up here.

Help clear the Wetlands of these Raptors, adventurer.  Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers are just West of the bluff there.  Kill 10 of each, if you can.

That will be a good start to the vengeance I have planned for them.
narrative.objectives: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill 10 Mottled Screechers and 10 Mottled Raptors.
narrative.offerRewardText: Killing is a dirty business, but you did your job well, adventurer. If I weren't obligated to stay with the Prospector and Merrin, I'd be down there shedding blood right along side you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Kill 10 Mottled Raptors and 10 Mottled Screechers, adventurer. My co-workers did not deserve the fate that was brought upon them. It's time to even the score.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 24 to 29, 7,100 XP in all.
